cwd.description: Absolute path to the launch working directory. Must already exist and be a real named folder, not a bare '_' leaf.

prompt.description: The task text passed to the agent.

model.description: Harness-specific model id/alias. Independently settable on resume.

background.description: Whether to launch detached (non-blocking) or wait for completion.

resumeOf.description: Session ID to resume from. null means a fresh dispatch. Never leave this implicit.

label.description: Optional human-readable name for this dispatch, for ledger readability.

sessionBoundary.description: Explicit parent/child/session/identity boundary record. Use this to distinguish mechanical sidecar sessions from durable identities and to disposition accidental sidecars.

parentSessionId.description: Known parent task/session/thread id, if any. This is not the child session id.

parentRolloutId.description: Known parent rollout/transcript id, if any. This is evidence only, not a resume target unless the harness says so.

expected.description: What continuity semantics the dispatcher intended before launch.

sidecarIntent.description: Whether creation of a separate external process/session was intended.

durableIdentity.description: Whether the child has a deliberate durable identity beyond its mechanical session id.

durableIdentityRef.description: Reference to the authority assigning durable identity, when durableIdentity is assigned or candidate.

disposition.description: Operational disposition of this sidecar/session record.

notes.description: Bounded evidence summary for why this boundary/disposition was recorded.

disclosure.description: Prompt-disclosure record for agent-facing dispatch hygiene.

shown.description: Facts, artifacts, labels, or examples included in the receiving agent's prompt.

withheld.description: Relevant facts intentionally omitted from the prompt to avoid contamination or because they were parent-side only.

parentOnly.description: Parent strategy, hypotheses, evaluation criteria, or routing notes not shared with the receiving agent.

unverified.description: Claims the receiving agent should not treat as established evidence.
